descriptionChirho: The proper name Yotam (יוֹתָם), meaning 'YHWH is perfect/complete,' referring to Jotham son of Gideon (Judg 9) and Jotham king of Judah (2 Kgs 15, 2 Chr 27, Isa 1:1, Hos 1:1, Mic 1:1). All three clusters are the same name with different prepositional frames: bare or with waw-copulative (S101596, 22x), with lamed-of-direction 'to Jotham' (S101598, 1x), and lamed-of-possession 'of Jotham' (S101599, 1x). Translational evidence is uniform: Spanish Jotam/Yotam, Arabic يُوثَامُ (Yūthām), Hindi योताम (Yotām), Korean 요탐 (Yotam), Swahili Yothamu.
